user.title: Connect to Sara
user.description: The address of your Sara server, as you open it in a browser (for example {example_lan} or {example_domain}).

data_description.url: Home Assistant asks Sara for a sign-in code; you approve it in Sara.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Sara again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant isn't signed in to Sara at {url} any more (it was signed out, or the device token expired). Submit to get a new code to approve in Sara.

disclosure.title: Sara's AI disclosure
disclosure.description:
{disclosure}

Sara shows this once before she answers. Accept it to continue.

progress.wait_for_approval:
In Sara, approve the sign-in for **Home Assistant**:

1. Open {approve_in}, or {verify_url} in a browser where you're signed in to Sara.
2. Type this code: **{code}**
3. Confirm it's you (owner token, two-step code or passkey) and press Approve.

This page continues by itself. The code lasts 10 minutes.

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like an address. Use something like {example_lan}.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Sara at that address. Is it right, and is Sara running?
error.must_accept: Accept the disclosure to use Sara from Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Sara server is already set up.
abort.denied: The sign-in was declined in Sara.
abort.expired: The code expired before it was approved. Try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Sara at that address. Is it right, and is Sara running?

init.title: Sara options
init.description: How Home Assistant talks to Sara.

data.share_context: Tell her where you're talking from

data_description.share_context: Adds the voice device and its area to what you say (for example "Kitchen speaker in the Kitchen").
data_description.one_conversation: On: everything from Home Assistant goes into a single "Home Assistant" conversation in Sara. Off: each Assist conversation gets its own.

send_message.name: Send a message
send_message.description: Sends a message to Sara and returns her reply.

conversation_id.name: Conversation
conversation_id.description: A Sara conversation id. Empty: her "Home Assistant" conversation.

config_entry_id.name: Sara
config_entry_id.description: Which Sara (when you have more than one).

not_loaded.message: Sara isn't set up or isn't loaded.

which_entry.message: More than one Sara is set up: choose which one.

auth.message: Home Assistant isn't signed in to Sara any more. Sign in again from the notification in Settings.

disclosure.message: Accept Sara's AI disclosure first (in Sara, or by setting up the integration again).

unknown_conversation.message: That conversation wasn't made by Home Assistant. Leave conversation_id out to use her Home Assistant conversation, or use an id this integration returned.
